text:
sara: Quick sync — planning a canary rollout for model v3 today. Goal: validate latency and hallucination rate on small traffic. Proposing percent-based ramp + region gating. Who's available for a quick review?

mohit: +1. Proposed plan: 2% -> 10% -> 25% over ~3 hours. Stop/roll back if avg p99 latency increases >40ms or error rate +0.5% absolute. Also whitelist 5 pilot customers for immediate opt-in.

dana: Add guardrail: if token-level cost per request jumps >20% we pause too. Also set an automatic fallback to v2 for requests flagged by content-safety or high response-time.

olga: For region gating, suggest EU first (staging traffic already mirrors EU). Ramp US after the 10% step. We'll use the region tag in routing: `region=eu` and `region=us` buckets.

mohit: Feature flag key: `inference.model_v3.canary`. Two dimensions: `pct` and `region`. We'll use the toggler service to set JSON config, e.g.
```
{ "key": "inference.model_v3.canary", "pct": 2, "regions": ["eu"] }
```
I'll push the initial flag and leave it disabled until infra check passes.

sara: Who will run infra checks? Need confirmation that rolling restart won't evict critical capacity.

olga: I'll run a dry-run on staging (same autoscaling policies). ETA 25m.

deploy-bot: Canary flag created (id: cf_7a9b). Status: pending. Link: https://console.redwood/cf/cf_7a9b

mohit: Quick rollback snippet (ops):
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 https://api.redwood/toggles/cf_7a9b/disable
```

dana: Can we add a regression eval job that runs checks on a batch of 500 prompts against our smoke suite and reports diffs to #eng-runtime? If regression score drops >3 pts we auto-pause.

sara: Yes — please wire eval and add a runbook section for manual rollback. I'll create a tiny checklist in the rollout doc and tag the oncall.

mohit: All noted. I'll create the flag, add the pilot customers list, and post back when initial 2% is live.

sara: Thanks — ping here when live. :thumbsup:
